brief:
Settlers staged an incursion into the edges of Burqa village, located east of Ramallah in the central West Bank, Shehab Wire reported. The raid represents the latest in a series of settler operations targeting Palestinian communities in the region.

The circumstances surrounding the intrusion remain unclear, with no immediate reports on the scale of the operation or whether it resulted in confrontations with Palestinian residents. Burqa lies in an area that has experienced repeated settler activity over recent months.
